text:
I went once and the service was terrible. It seemed like there were very few doctors available.
The doctor herself was also impolite, speaking as if I was begging for treatment. I'd rather go to another clinic next time. There are many good ones in Chiang Mai.
I recommend you avoid this place. I made the mistake of going because I had just moved to Chiang Mai at that time.
Excellent service, great price. Will definitely come again. Highly recommend!
